title: Gallaudet briefs the Japanese Diet's UAP caucus

tellings.quote: know that I gave a virtual presentation to this UAP caucus in the parliament or diet

plain: Japan's parliament, the Diet, has a group of lawmakers devoted to UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, and a retired US Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says he briefed them. He tells Michels that around 2024 or 2025 he "gave a virtual presentation to this UAP caucus." If so, the subject has reached lawmakers well beyond Washington.
